data.name: Dwarakaa
data.long_meaning: Dwarakaa is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is the consort of Lord Vishnu and is particularly revered in the city of Dwarka. Dwarakaa is believed to bestow her blessings upon her devotees, bringing them wealth, happiness, and prosperity.

historical_references.reference: According to Hindu mythology, Dwarka is the name of a legendary city in India, believed to be the capital of the Yadava dynasty, where Lord Krishna resided towards the end of his earthly life.

The name Dwarka is mentioned in the ancient Indian texts, Rigveda and Mahabharata, as the name of a city believed to have been founded by the god, Vishnu, and later served as the capital city of the Yadavas under the rule of Krishna.
